summary: Steve Midlarsky, 63, of Florida fell into the Roaring Fork River at the Devil's Punchbowl cliff-diving and swimming spot on Independence Pass near Aspen and was missing overnight; his body was recovered the next day
location: Devil's Punchbowl, Roaring Fork River, Independence Pass, near Aspen
notes: Reported via AP/CPR 2022-06-19: missing Wednesday 2022-06-15 after an accidental fall (fully clothed), body found Thursday by a search team. Responding agency not stated in the report.
